

```{r}
# Load in packages
library(tidyverse)
library(spDataLarge)
library(sf)
library(stars)
library(terra)
library(gt)
library(tmap)
library(viridisLite)
```

```{r}
# Load in data

## shapefile for the West Coast EEZ
west_cost_eez <- st_read('data/wc_regions_clean.shp')

## bathymetry raster
depth <- rast('data/depth.tif')

## SST rasters (combine SST rasters into a raster stack)
SST8 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif')
SST9 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif')
SST10 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif')
SST11 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif')
SST12 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif')

## Merged SST rasters
SST_merge <- c(SST8, SST9, SST10, SST11, SST12)
```

```{r}
# Check for same CRS for all datasets
cat("\n=== Same CRS? ===\n")
cat("west cost ezz vs depth: ", same.crs(west_cost_eez, depth), "\n")
cat("west cost ezz vs SST merge: ", same.crs(west_cost_eez, SST_merge), "\n")
cat("depth vs SST merge: ", same.crs(depth, SST_merge), "\n")
```
